mainline/sanruan#1.zh: 北京大名府留守梁中书，是当朝蔡太师的女婿。每年六月十五蔡太师生辰，他都搜刮十万贯金珠宝贝，送上东京祝寿，唤做『生辰纲』。去年那一担半路被人劫了，至今没拿到贼。
mainline/sanruan#1.t: Secretary Liang, Regent of Daming Prefecture in the Northern Capital, is son-in-law to Grand Tutor Cai. Every year for Cai's birthday on the fifteenth of the sixth month, he scrapes together a hundred thousand strings' worth of gold and jewels and sends it to the Eastern Capital: the 'birthday gifts'. Last year's load was robbed on the road, and the thieves were never caught.

mainline/sanruan#2.zh: 今年的生辰纲又要上路了。『赤发鬼』刘唐把消息报给郓城县东溪村的晁保正，晁盖便请『智多星』吴用去石碣村，说那阮家三兄弟来入伙。
mainline/sanruan#2.t: This year's birthday gifts are about to set out again. 'Red-haired Demon' Liu Tang brought the news to Headman Chao of East Creek Village in Yuncheng County, and Chao Gai asked 'Wizard' Wu Yong to go to Stone Tablet Village and win over the three Ruan brothers.

mainline/sanruan#3.zh: 小生多时不见三位，今日特来相投，吃三杯。
mainline/sanruan#3.t: I haven't seen you three in a long while. I've come especially to share a few cups with you.

mainline/sanruan#4.zh: 教授来得正好！只是如今要几尾大鱼也难了。
mainline/sanruan#4.t: Good timing, Teacher! Only, these days even a few big fish are hard to come by.

mainline/sanruan#5.zh: 话没说完，湖边靠了一只船，几个喽啰跳上岸来。
mainline/sanruan#5.t: Before he could finish, a boat pulled up at the lakeshore and several bandits jumped ashore.

mainline/sanruan#6.zh: 兀那打鱼的！王头领有令，这泊子里一尾鱼也是山寨的，交出鱼来！
mainline/sanruan#6.t: Hey, fisherman! Chief Wang's orders: every fish in this marsh belongs to the stronghold. Hand them over!

mainline/sanruan#7.t: I've been itching for someone to take it out on today!

mainline/sanruan#9.zh: 胜利条件   --- 第 12 回合以后打败所有敌人（之前敌人打光，梁山还会再派喽啰来）
mainline/sanruan#9.t: Victory --- Defeat all enemies from turn 12 on (clear them earlier and Liangshan sends more)

mainline/sanruan#10.zh: 失败条件   --- 吴用死亡

mainline/sanruan#11.zh: 吴用表字学究，道号加亮先生，在东溪村教村塾。早年在石碣村住过几年，和阮家兄弟相熟。
mainline/sanruan#11.t: Wu Yong, styled Xuejiu, Taoist name Master Jialiang, teaches the village school in East Creek Village. He lived a few years in Stone Tablet Village and knows the Ruan brothers well.

mainline/sanruan#12.zh: 俺兄弟三个，排行第二的便是俺，人叫『立地太岁』。家里有老小，只靠这片湖打鱼过活，有时也做些私商勾当。
mainline/sanruan#12.t: There are three of us brothers, and I'm the second, called 'Earthly Demon'. I've a family to feed and live off fishing this lake, with a bit of smuggling now and then.

mainline/sanruan#13.t: Second Brother, as honest as ever.

mainline/sanruan#15.zh: 不好，他们从后面抄过来了！
mainline/sanruan#15.t: Oh no, they're coming round behind us!

mainline/sanruan#17.zh: 阮小五，人叫『短命二郎』，头上斜戴一顶破头巾，鬓边插朵石榴花，敞着胸脯，露出一个青郁郁的豹子。
mainline/sanruan#17.t: Ruan Xiaowu, called 'Short-lived Second Son', wears a ragged turban askew with a pomegranate flower at his temple, his chest bare to show a dark blue panther tattoo.

mainline/sanruan#18.t: Fifth Brother, gambling again the other day?

mainline/sanruan#19.zh: 休说！输得赤条条的，连老娘的钗子也押了。
mainline/sanruan#19.t: Don't mention it! Lost everything down to my shirt, even pawned my old mother's hairpin.

mainline/sanruan#20.zh: 阮小七，人叫『活阎罗』，兄弟里最小，还没娶亲，性子最急。
mainline/sanruan#20.t: Ruan Xiaoqi, called 'Living King of Hell', is the youngest brother, still unmarried, and the most hot-tempered.

mainline/sanruan#21.zh: 人生一世，草生一秋！俺们只管打鱼，一辈子也挣不到一碗好酒。
mainline/sanruan#21.t: A man lives one life, grass grows one autumn! Just fishing, we'll never earn a decent bowl of wine in our whole lives.

mainline/sanruan#22.zh: 你看那梁山泊上的人，论秤分金银，成瓮吃酒，大块吃肉，好不快活！
mainline/sanruan#22.t: Look at those men on Liangshan Marsh: they weigh out gold and silver by the scale, drink wine by the jar and eat meat by the slab. What a life!

mainline/sanruan#24.zh: 好大胆，敢打梁山的人！一发拿了，绑上山去见王头领！
mainline/sanruan#24.t: What nerve, striking Liangshan's men! Seize them all and haul them up the mountain to Chief Wang!

mainline/sanruan#25.t: Who's in charge on Liangshan Marsh now?

mainline/sanruan#26.zh: 为头的是个落第秀才，唤做『白衣秀士』王伦；第二个『摸着天』杜迁，第三个『云里金刚』宋万，岸边还开着一家酒店，是『旱地忽律』朱贵做眼。
mainline/sanruan#26.t: The leader is a failed examination candidate called 'White-clad Scholar' Wang Lun; second is 'Sky Toucher' Du Qian, third 'Cloud Guardian' Song Wan. And there's a tavern on the shore where 'Dry-Land Crocodile' Zhu Gui keeps watch.

mainline/sanruan#27.zh: 那王伦心地窄狭，安不得人。俺们兄弟也想过去入伙，见他这般，便罢了。
mainline/sanruan#27.t: That Wang Lun is narrow-minded and can't tolerate others. We brothers thought of joining, but seeing how he is, we gave up.

mainline/sanruan#28.zh: 这等强人，官司怎不来拿？
mainline/sanruan#28.t: Bandits like that, and the authorities don't come to arrest them?

mainline/sanruan#29.zh: 官司？官司一处处动弹，便害百姓！但一声下乡村来，倒先把好百姓家养的猪羊鸡鹅都吃了，又要盘缠打发他。
mainline/sanruan#29.t: The authorities? Wherever they stir, the people suffer! The moment they come down to the villages, they eat every pig, sheep, chicken and goose the good folk raise, and want travel money on top.

mainline/sanruan#30.zh: 如今官差都怕了那伙强人，倒不敢下乡来了，落得清静。
mainline/sanruan#30.t: Now the officers are scared of that gang and don't dare come down to the villages. At least it's quiet.

mainline/sanruan#31.zh: 假如有人识得你们，带挈你们去做一番事业，你们肯去么？
mainline/sanruan#31.t: Suppose someone recognised your worth and led you to do something great. Would you go?

mainline/sanruan#32.zh: 若是有识我们的，水里水里去，火里火里去！
mainline/sanruan#32.t: If there were someone who knew our worth, we'd go through water and through fire!

mainline/sanruan#33.t: Only there's no one who knows our worth.

mainline/sanruan#34.zh: （待打退了这伙人，再与他们细说生辰纲的事。）
mainline/sanruan#34.t: (Once we've beaten off this lot, I'll tell them about the birthday gifts.)

mainline/sanruan#35.zh: 教授是读书人，躲在俺们背后便是！
mainline/sanruan#35.t: Teacher, you're a scholar. Just stay behind us!

mainline/sanruan#36.zh: 湖上又摇来一只船，又跳上几个喽啰来！
mainline/sanruan#36.t: Another boat rowed across the lake, and more bandits jumped ashore!

mainline/sanruan#37.zh: 芦苇里又钻出几个喽啰来！
mainline/sanruan#37.t: More bandits burst out of the reeds!

mainline/sanruan#38.zh: 湖上又摇来一只船，又跳上几个喽啰来！
mainline/sanruan#38.t: Another boat rowed across the lake, and more bandits jumped ashore!

mainline/sanruan#39.zh: 芦苇里又钻出几个喽啰来！
mainline/sanruan#39.t: More bandits burst out of the reeds!

mainline/sanruan#40.zh: 湖上又摇来一只船，又跳上几个喽啰来！
mainline/sanruan#40.t: Another boat rowed across the lake, and more bandits jumped ashore!

mainline/sanruan#41.zh: 芦苇里又钻出几个喽啰来！
mainline/sanruan#41.t: More bandits burst out of the reeds!

mainline/sanruan#43.zh: 这等鸟人，也只会欺负打鱼的！
mainline/sanruan#43.t: Scum like you can only bully fishermen!

mainline/sanruan#44.zh: 喽啰们死的死、逃的逃，余下的跳上船，往梁山泊去了。
mainline/sanruan#44.t: The bandits were killed or fled; the rest jumped into their boats and made for Liangshan Marsh.

mainline/sanruan#45.zh: 东溪村晁保正，三位可曾认得？
mainline/sanruan#45.t: Headman Chao of East Creek Village: do you three know him?

mainline/sanruan#46.zh: 闻名不曾相会。都说他仗义疏财，是个好男子。
mainline/sanruan#46.t: We know his name but have never met him. They say he's generous and righteous, a fine man.

mainline/sanruan#47.zh: 实不相瞒：北京梁中书收买了十万贯金珠宝贝，早晚要起程，送上东京与他丈人蔡太师庆生辰。
mainline/sanruan#47.t: To be frank: Secretary Liang of the Northern Capital has bought a hundred thousand strings' worth of gold and jewels and will soon send them to the Eastern Capital for his father-in-law Grand Tutor Cai's birthday.

mainline/sanruan#48.zh: 这都是刮的民脂民膏，取之何碍！前日有个好汉『赤发鬼』刘唐，特来报与晁保正知道。
mainline/sanruan#48.t: It's all wrung from the people's sweat and blood; what harm in taking it! The other day a hero, 'Red-haired Demon' Liu Tang, came especially to tell Headman Chao.

mainline/sanruan#49.zh: 那夜晁保正梦见北斗七星，直坠在他屋脊上，斗柄上另有一颗小星化道白光去了。小生想来，正应了七个好汉，因此特来请三位。
mainline/sanruan#49.t: That night Headman Chao dreamed the seven stars of the Dipper fell straight onto his roof, and a small star on the handle turned into a white light and flew off. I think it means seven heroes, so I came especially to invite you three.

mainline/sanruan#50.zh: 十万贯！……去年那一担也是半路被人劫了，官司至今拿不着人。
mainline/sanruan#50.t: A hundred thousand strings! ...Last year's load was robbed on the road too, and the authorities still haven't caught anyone.

mainline/sanruan#51.zh: 这腔热血，只要卖与识货的！
mainline/sanruan#51.t: This hot blood of mine is only for sale to someone who knows its worth!

mainline/sanruan#52.zh: 这腔热血，只要卖与识货的！
mainline/sanruan#52.t: This hot blood of mine is only for sale to someone who knows its worth!

mainline/sanruan#53.zh: 教授，俺们兄弟三个，都跟晁保正去！
mainline/sanruan#53.t: Teacher, all three of us brothers will follow Headman Chao!

mainline/sanruan#54.zh: 阮氏三雄入伙！吴用领着三兄弟回到东溪村，又有公孙胜、白胜相投，七星聚义，定下智取生辰纲之计。
mainline/sanruan#54.t: The three Ruan heroes join! Wu Yong led the brothers back to East Creek Village, where Gongsun Sheng and Bai Sheng also joined. The seven stars gathered and laid the plan to seize the birthday gifts by guile.

mainline/sanruan#55.zh: 吴用倒在湖边，三阮救之不及。晁盖少了军师，生辰纲之计也就此作罢……
mainline/sanruan#55.t: Wu Yong fell by the lake before the Ruan brothers could save him. Without its strategist, Chao Gai's plan for the birthday gifts came to nothing...
